question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

The statistical study of human populations.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**Demography**" refers to the statistical study of human populations, including their size, structure, and distribution.

Hence, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: Photography relates to capturing images, unrelated to population studies.
 
• Option 2: Palaeography is the study of ancient writing systems and manuscripts.
 
• Option 3: Astronomy deals with celestial objects and phenomena, not human populations.
